title: Manage RStudio Preferences and Addin Shortcuts
text: Manage RStudio preferences addin shortcuts {rstudio.prefs} package provides programmatic interface working RStudio preference files modify settings addin keyboard shortcuts without using point--click option menus. useful teams individuals working across multiple devices want unified experience enforcing best practices. package also exposes settings available Global Options dialog.

title: Normalize Path Add-in — make_path_norm
text: Add keyboard shortcut make_path_norm() RStudio, use use_rstudio_keyboard_shortcut() function. add manually, follow instructions . Install rstudio.prefs, restart RStudio Select "Tools" –> "Modify Keyboard Shortcuts...". Search box, type "Make Path Normal". Click "Shortcut" column "Make Path Normal" row. Press intended shortcut keys (suggested: Ctrl+Shift+/) set shortcut. NOTE: possible override previously specified key combination selection.

title: Normalize Path Add-in — make_path_norm
code: if (interactive()) {   # set a keyboard shortcut for path normalization   rstudio.prefs::use_rstudio_keyboard_shortcut(     "Ctrl+Shift+/" = "rstudio.prefs::make_path_norm"   ) }
